---
title: Demonstration Video
---

# Requirements
The rules for the **Video Material** (demo video) are a critical part
of the **Preliminary Design Review (PDR) Step 2** and serve as a
primary basis for qualification for the ERC 2026 finals,. Teams must
prepare this promotional material to demonstrate their readiness and
the technical capabilities of their hardware,.

## Submission and Technical Requirements
-   **Deadline:** The video must be submitted by **31 May 2026** (23:59 CEST),,,.
-   **Length:** The maximum allowed length is **10 minutes**,,,.
-   **Platform:** It should be uploaded to a popular video service
    (like **YouTube**), made publicly available, and the link must be
    delivered via the official online form,,,.
-   **Aesthetics:** The video is scored on visual aesthetics and the
    presentation skills of the team,.

## Mandatory Content and Sequence
The video must follow a **strict sequence** (Sections 1–7) to ensure
judges can easily identify and score each element. Failure to follow
this sequence may result in a score of **0 points** for missed
elements. The required sections are:

1.  **Introduction:** Team name, rover name, and university name,.
2.  **Team Introduction:** Presenting team members, their functions,
    and organizational structure,,.
3.  **Reasons for Participation:** Explaining the motivation for
    entering the ERC,,.
4.  **Rover Demonstration:** Mobility, remote control, design, and safety,.
5.  **Drone Demonstration:** Mobility, remote control, design, and safety,.
6.  **Tools:** Demonstration of the manipulator, drill, gripper, or
    other tools,.
7.  **Quality:** Overall aesthetics and presentation,.

## Crucial Mobility "No-Cut" Rules
The sources emphasize that certain maneuvers **must be recorded in a
single sequence without any video cuts**. Intentional manipulation to
bypass these rules carries a heavy **-30 point penalty**.

-   **For the Rover:** A single, continuous shot must show the rover
    **roving forward, then backward, and turning right, then
    left**,,. A separate cut is permitted to show driving on slopes
    and the **emergency stop button** performance.
-   **For the Drone:** A single, continuous shot must show **take-off,
    flying along all three axes** (up/down, right/left, front/back),
    and **landing**,. A separate cut is allowed to demonstrate the
    **autoland** safety feature,.

## Scoring and Penalties
The video material is worth a maximum of **100 points** toward the
total documentation score.

Key penalties include:

- **Wrong Sequence:** -5 points.
- **Exceeded Length:** -10 points.
- **Cuts in Mandatory Sequences:** -5 points.
- **Intentional Manipulation:** -30 points.

__Pro-tip:__ To ensure judges do not miss critical features, it is
highly recommended to provide **timestamps** in the video description
or display **small titles** in the corner of the screen for each
section.
